name: 陈野

character.name: 陈野
character.personality: 爽朗、踏实、有团队意识，习惯自己扛任务
character.direction_zh: 比小帅稍结实、偏中音的少年男声，爽朗放松，鼓励别人时自然平等；仍有高中生年龄感。
character.instruct: A 17-year-old male high-school basketball teammate. A youthful medium-register male voice, slightly fuller and more grounded than a light tenor, with a small amount of natural teenage roughness. Friendly, straightforward, relaxed and dependable. He encourages a teammate as an equal, with an easy smile and unforced confidence. Keep light adolescent resonance and conversational phrasing. No deep adult coach voice, shouting or sports-announcer performance.
character.text: You don't have to be the best player on your first day. Watch where your teammates are, and give yourself time to learn. If you need a break, say so. We're on the same team, and asking for help is part of playing together.

full_instruction: A 17-year-old male high-school basketball teammate. A youthful medium-register male voice, slightly fuller and more grounded than a light tenor, with a small amount of natural teenage roughness. Friendly, straightforward, relaxed and dependable. He encourages a teammate as an equal, with an easy smile and unforced confidence. Keep light adolescent resonance and conversational phrasing. No deep adult coach voice, shouting or sports-announcer performance. Speak clear, natural conversational American English. Use a comfortable medium pace and natural sentence pauses so a high-school English learner can follow. Keep an everyday human delivery, with no music or sound effects, no announcer performance, and no theatrical exaggeration. Read only the supplied text.
